claims.location: comment[data file] and assay name rows 1-6
claims.evidence: The accession-scoped PRIDE list includes all six R1276 .d.zip files. search_R1276.zip/combined/txt/summary.txt maps each raw run name to MaxQuant experiments S01 through S06.

claims.location: source name, characteristics[biological replicate], characteristics[pooled sample], comment[technical replicate], characteristics[genotype], factor value[genotype] rows 1-6
claims.value: one pooled PafA-LTI6B control and one pooled cc1cc2 double-mutant PafA-CC1 source, each split into three IP replicates
claims.evidence: The PRIDE sample processing protocol states that three independent Arabidopsis transgenic lines were mixed and processed similarly to Nicotiana extracts split into three independent immunoprecipitations. Thus biological replicate is one per pooled source and technical replicate is 1-3 within each genotype. Supplementary Data 4 sheet 'CC1 and LTI6B LFQ (Ara)' labels six columns Lti6B_rep1-3 and CC1_rep1-3. Matching each protein ID and log2 LFQ intensity against search_R1276 proteinGroups.txt identifies S01-S06 in that order: 1239, 1243, 1205, 1396, 1368 and 1371 exact nonzero protein-intensity matches, respectively (absolute difference <0.0001). The paper identifies PafA-LTI6B as control and states PafA-CC1 was transformed into cc1cc2 double mutant plants. It does not explicitly identify the LTI6B background. The six-way mapping is recorded in results/denmark/PXD048346_R1276_run_map.tsv.

claims.location: characteristics[organism], characteristics[organism part], characteristics[developmental stage], characteristics[growth condition] rows 1-6
claims.value: Arabidopsis thaliana whole six-day-old seedlings grown in liquid half-strength MS medium; seedling development stage PO:0007131
claims.evidence: The Arabidopsis transgenic methods state that seedlings were grown in liquid 1/2 MS medium for six days to generate tissue for IP-MS; the results identify six-day-old seedlings for FLAG-Pup(E) enrichment. Plant Ontology identifies seedling development stage as PO:0007131.

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[instrument], comment[cleavage agent details] rows 1-6
claims.value: DDA PASEF on timsTOF Pro with physical trypsin digestion
claims.evidence: The paper's enrichment LC-MS method reports digestion with 20 micrograms/ml trypsin and timsTOF Pro in PASEF mode. R1276 summary.txt lists all six runs as TIMS-DDA. Its Trypsin/P designation is a MaxQuant search setting, not the digestion reagent.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance], comment[modification parameters] rows 1-6
claims.value: 10 ppm, 40 ppm, fixed carbamidomethyl C, variable oxidation M and protein N-terminal acetylation
claims.evidence: The R1276 MaxQuant mqpar.xml and parameters.txt give the mass tolerances and modifications; summary.txt confirms the modifications for every run.

limitations: This SDRF covers only six R1276 Arabidopsis RAW archives out of 33 RAW archives in PXD048346. Other subexperiments require separate annotation.

The accession-wide PRIDE protocol combines different subexperiments and mentions Q Exactive HF and Trypsin/Lys-C. The R1276-specific MaxQuant search output and paper's timsTOF enrichment method are used for these six runs; an accession-level reconcile comparison reports apparent instrument and enzyme conflicts.

The installed plants template gives 'seedling stage' as an example, but the official validator's cached EFO lookup does not recognize that label. The valid PO:0007131 term 'seedling development stage' is used and passes official validation without warnings.
The paper does not explicitly establish the genetic background of PafA-LTI6B control plants. No cc1cc2 background is inferred for those rows.

The published rep1-rep3 sample labels distinguish IP splits, not separate plant donors. The accession's sample processing protocol says three independent transgenic lines were mixed before the similar split; the SDRF records one pooled source per construct.
